title: Grep
description: Search file contents using ripgrep 14. Supports the full ripgrep regex syntax. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers.

pattern.description: ripgrep regex pattern. See https://docs.rs/regex/latest/regex/#syntax for the syntax.

path.description: Directory to search in. Default: workspace root. Must be inside the workspace.

glob.description: Glob filter (e.g. '*.ts', 'src/**/*.tsx'). Passes through to ripgrep -g.

multiline.description: Enable ripgrep -U for cross-line patterns. Use with caution — slower.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return. Default 100.

output_mode.description: Output mode. 'content' returns matching lines; 'files_with_matches' returns just file paths; 'count' returns match counts per file.
